testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-signed-in.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23106 sales rep users list shows only assigned users

scenario.summary: A sales rep with one assigned user signs in to admin, opens Customers > Users and sees the assigned user but not a user of the same store who is not assigned to it.
steps: Sign in to the admin panel as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password).
Search the list for the assigned user (@assigned.userName) and the other user (@other.userName).
assertions: @other.userName is not listed (No records found. when searched)
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Store Assignment Rules' and the Sales Rep login sections: a sales rep sees only its assigned users.
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (analysis answer 2).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
